parsed.explanation: Chain value v(B) is defined via the decreasing order, but Lemma 4.1 only produces some ordering with nested value g; the objection's example ({10,9,8,7,5}, P={8,7,5}, N={10,9}, all subset sums integral so none strictly between 19 and 20, decreasing residue 5 ≠ 1) shows order matters, so Theorem 4.2 as literally stated is not proved. However the substantive upper-bound machinery (pigeonhole on 2^{n+1} subset sums, greedy realizability, the running-piece cut construction, cut count (r-1)+(n+1-r)=n, and pairwise cancellation) is order-agnostic and complete; only the definition/sort convention is wrong. Repair: define v(B) as the nested value over the ordering supplied by Lemma 4.1 (one sentence).
